title: Standard security questionnaire (Full)
description: A complete security due-diligence questionnaire for vendors that host, process or can access your confidential data or production systems. Organised in the domains used by common industry questionnaires and referenced to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and SOC 2 so vendors can answer from existing audit material. Written in-house; it does not reproduce SIG, CAIQ or any licensed questionnaire.

title: Standard security questionnaire (Lite)
description: The essential questions from the full standard questionnaire, for vendors with limited access to your data or systems. Same question IDs as the full version, so answers stay comparable if you later send the full set.

title: Quick security baseline
description: Core security questions for any vendor with access to your systems or confidential data. Written in-house; aligned with ISO 27001 Annex A and SOC 2 topics without reproducing either standard.

title: Add-on: DPDP Data Processor
description: For vendors that process personal data on your behalf. Under the DPDP Act your company remains responsible for processing done by its Data Processors (s.8(1)) and must engage them only under a valid contract (s.8(2)).

title: Add-on: GDPR processor (Article 28)
description: For vendors that process personal data of people in the EU or UK on your behalf. Covers the Article 28 processor terms, international transfers and breach support. Send alongside a core security questionnaire.

title: Add-on: AI and machine learning vendor
description: For vendors whose product uses AI or machine learning on your data, or that supply AI models or services. Covers training on customer data, model providers, safety testing and transparency. Aligned with ISO/IEC 42001 topics.

title: Add-on: Payment card data (PCI DSS)
description: For payment gateways, processors and any vendor that stores, processes or transmits card data for you, or can affect the security of your payment pages.
